$lines: Save or read this episode's brief ordinary-language task plan, dynamic attention list and short evidence ledger. Submit plan before the first physical action, including a wait, and always include ledger explicitly (use [] when no material prerequisite is unresolved). Suggested plan headings: Task understanding; Approach + completion. Keep only currently relevant concerns, evidence/adjustments and check times in attention. When a material task-result prerequisite is unresolved and a later decision depends on it, keep only one to three short ledger rows. The ledger has at most 3 task prerequisites or expected events with status=pending|supported|contradicted|unknown, a short permitted evidence basis and the next distinguishing check. After contradicted evidence, change the contact, route or target mechanism, or state that no distinguishing next step is supported. It is an advisory decision boundary: completed motion, preview success and closed gripper do not prove an object result, and pending rows do not block useful actions. Add, replace or remove rows as evidence changes, without updating after every motion. Prefer normal task-progress actions' final observations; add a probe only when missing evidence affects the next decision. Plans, attention and ledger are advisory and do not execute or constrain later actions. update accepts plan, attention, ledger or any combination; omitted fields are retained and [] clears a list; when a ledger value changes, include the replacement ledger. Repeating the same field values at the same observation returns status=unchanged without a new revision; the same values at a newer observation record a new judgment source. submit/update return a plan ID and acknowledgement; read returns the current plan, attention, ledger and field-source observation IDs, and accepts only operation. Examples (replace IDs/pixels with actual saved evidence): {"ledger":[],"observation_id":"obs_1","operation":"submit","plan":"Task understanding: move the visible target to its support. Approach + completion: choose a clear grasp and route, release, then verify stable placement."} ; {"attention":[{"check":"Use visible object-to-finger alignment; if it shifted, adjust the placement approach.","concern":"The object may have shifted in the gripper.","when":"From the normal transfer action's final observation, before placement."}],"operation":"update"} ; {"attention":[],"operation":"update"} ; {"operation":"read"}

$lines: Unified bounded robot action. Default mode=preview plans the COMPLETE single/dual-arm stage batch without physics, returns plan_id, cost, exact trajectory and calibrated robot-geometry evidence. Review it, then call this SAME tool with mode=execute and plan_id to execute those exact cached rows. No silent replanning or changed commands. mode=execute_if_clean (or auto_execute_if_clean=true) plans the complete batch, runs motion_safety, grasp_3d_review and geometry_review, and immediately executes in the SAME call when all checks pass with zero warnings/risks (automatically returning the preview plan_id without moving if any warning or risk is detected). mode=direct explicitly previews and immediately executes without returning for model review. Optional plan_update submits or updates task_plan inline in the same call without a separate task_plan round trip. stages are ordered per arm; IDs are unique and depends_on adds cross-arm completion dependencies. move uses grasp_position_m in env_origin metres and angles_deg=[pitch,roll,yaw] world rotations from the top-down reference, not conventional absolute Euler angles. Choose contact_region/contact_depth_m at each stage. Alternatively move uses position_m + quaternion_xyzw for a measured link6/flange target. Supply exactly one complete pose pair. Routes use successive move stages, not via fields. There are no joint/home/reset kinds; a return uses saved measured poses. Every move has its own arm speed and optional gripper_goal_normalized/speed; gripper_motion fractions synchronize that jaw within THIS move. Without fractions its jaw runs after measured arrival. A gripper stage requires goal_normalized (0 closed, 1 open), not gripper or goal. observe requires reason and stops BOTH arms; omit arm for a barrier after both prior arm stages, or name an arm to checkpoint when only that arm arrives. Later stages remain cached. After inspecting RGB, execute the same plan_id to continue only if its current-state validity check passes; otherwise preview a new plan. Optional checkpoint_after_gripper=true (on a grasp/gripper stage or the batch) pauses after a jaw stage before the next move stage (pre-lift) to inspect finger contact and grip_facts in RGB before continuing the cached plan_id; or use grip_guard_preset (non_empty [>=2mm], thin_object [>=0.5mm], rigid_object [>=4mm], wide_object [>=15mm], none) and min_aperture_m/max_aperture_m [0..0.088m] to conditionally pause only when measured_aperture_m falls outside the expected bounds (valid grasps continue into lift without pausing). Use tolerance_preset (tight, normal, relaxed, coarse, unconstrained_orientation) or position_tolerance_m/orientation_tolerance_rad per stage, and set stall_guard_preset="contact_stop" specifically on contact descent/press stages (keep batch default "off" for free-space transits). Use joint_travel_preset (standard, extended, unconstrained) or max_joint_travel_rad/max_backtracking_rad on move stages or the batch when legitimate large wrist rotations need wider travel thresholds. Independent arm sequences overlap. Express paired barriers using depends_on; arrival/closed-jaw commands do not prove contact, support or retention. Shared rows cost one native step; the complete batch retains one 250-step budget including resumed portions. mode=inspect accepts plan_id for cached evidence, action_id for executed measured/planned paths, or trajectory_ref for an existing artifact; path_kind selects measured/planned. Supply observed/estimated obstacles world AABBs and held_objects={left/right: current world AABB} for full-timeline proxy clearance estimates; contact declarations annotate overlaps without suppressing risks. Auxiliary review is reserved; the main model owns execution approval. Geometry risks are advisory, not a joint-collision, environment-collision or shared-object constraint proof. Usage: preview/execute_if_clean/direct require current observation_id and either 1..32 stages, source_plan_id + start_from_stage_id (with optional stage_overrides to recompile remaining stages from current measured state), or plan_id + skip_failed_stage/partial stages (from repair_action); execute accepts plan_id, optional action_id and expected_cursor/expected_revision; inspect requires exactly one plan_id/action_id/trajectory_ref plus inspection options. Example checkpoint preview: {"observation_id":"obs1","stages":[{"id":"check","kind":"observe","reason":"inspect current support"}]}. After reviewing a returned plan: {"mode":"execute","plan_id":"p1","expected_cursor":0,"expected_revision":0}. Explicit continuation after a paused/failed stage: {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","source_plan_id":"p1","start_from_stage_id":"carry","stage_overrides":{"carry":{"position_tolerance_m":0.015}}} or {"mode":"preview","observation_id":"obs2","plan_id":"p1","skip_failed_stage":true}. Gripper stage syntax: {"id":"open","kind":"gripper","arm":"left","goal_normalized":1}; choose the goal from the intended action.

expected_revision.description: Execute only: expected plan revision; use returned next_action. Omission uses current cached revision.

position_m.description: Move only: target link6/flange [x,y,z] in env_origin metres, paired with quaternion_xyzw; mutually exclusive with grasp pose/contact fields.

quaternion_xyzw.description: Move only: link6/flange orientation [x,y,z,w], a unit quaternion in env_origin; paired with position_m.

contact_region.description: Grasp move only: pad_center (default, fingertips 7.5 mm beyond target along tool +x), finger_middle (27.5 mm toward palm, fingertips 35 mm beyond target), or fingertip (at target). speed_preset.description: Move only: named arm speed; slower=0.5, slow=0.8, careful=0.9, normal=1, fast=1.25, faster=1.5. Choose this or speed_scale.

gripper_speed_preset.description: Jaw speed: slower=0.5, slow=0.8 or normal=1; choose this or gripper_speed_scale. On move requires gripper_goal_normalized.

gripper_goal_normalized.description: Move only: jaw target [0,1], 0 closed and 1 open; omission preserves the last commanded goal, not the measured opening or a guaranteed grip force. start_fraction.description: Start fraction of move in [0,1), strictly before end_fraction.

end_fraction.description: End fraction of move in (0,1], strictly after start_fraction.

gripper_motion.description: Move only: synchronize jaw motion over start_fraction..end_fraction of this move, with start < end; requires gripper_goal_normalized.

checkpoint_after_gripper.description: Move (with gripper_goal_normalized) or gripper stage only: optional on-demand boolean (default inherits batch checkpoint_after_gripper, which defaults to false). grip_guard_preset.description: Move or gripper stage: optional aperture guard preset (none, non_empty [min 0.002m], thin_object [min 0.0005m], rigid_object [min 0.004m], wide_object [min 0.015m]). min_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional minimum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m; default none/disabled). max_aperture_m.description: Move or gripper stage: optional maximum expected fingertip aperture in metres [0, 0.088] (full open 88mm, closed 0m). Pauses with aperture_above_max_m if measured_aperture_m > max_aperture_m; overrides preset upper bound.

joint_travel_preset.description: Move only: optional joint-travel admission preset: standard (default, total<=pi or excess<pi/2), extended (total<=1.5*pi or excess<pi for wide-arc sweeps, large orientation flips or deformable folding), or unconstrained (disables travel/backtracking rejection while keeping step-budget checks).

max_joint_travel_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint total travel threshold in radians (>0) before backtracking/winding checks apply; overrides joint_travel_preset.

max_backtracking_rad.description: Move only: optional custom per-joint backtracking/periodic-winding excess threshold in radians (>0); overrides joint_travel_preset.

tolerance_preset.description: Move only: named arrival tolerance preset; tight=(0.003 m, 0.05 rad) strictly for final millimeter-clearance pin/slot insertion (avoid tight on tabletop grasps or pushing where PD droop/friction is ~4-6mm), normal=(0.010 m, 0.15 rad, default; requires <=10 mm horizontal alignment with vertical contact/load compliance), relaxed/compliant=(0.015 m, 0.20 rad) for compliant placement, coarse=(0.025 m, 0.35 rad) for large-clearance transit/retract, unconstrained_orientation=(0.015 m, 3.14159 rad) when wrist orientation around a symmetric target is free. Explicit position_tolerance_m, orientation_tolerance_rad or max_upward_dz_m overrides the corresponding component.

position_tolerance_m.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival position tolerance in metres, positive and at most 0.10. Tracking failure stops later stages, including gripper commands, and returns endpoint_residual_m={dx_m,dy_m,dz_m,position_error_m,orientation_error_rad}, first_divergence, contact_block_summary, in_hand_tracking_error (true when an object remains held between the fingers at a blocked pose) and next_action.

orientation_tolerance_rad.description: Move only: measured link6 arrival orientation tolerance in radians, in (0, pi]. Overrides the orientation component of tolerance_preset (default normal=0.15 rad).

max_upward_dz_m.description: Move only: optional vertical Z compliance window override in metres [0, 0.15] when horizontal (dx, dy) and orientation are within tolerance and measured Z rests above target (+dz_m <= max_upward_dz_m). clearance_preset.description: Move only: optional obstacle-crossing vertical clearance preset (none=0 m, low=0.09 m, normal=0.13 m default, high=0.18 m) when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_height_m.

clearance_height_m.description: Move only: optional custom obstacle-crossing vertical clearance height in metres [0, 0.25] above obstacle top when obstacles are supplied; mutually exclusive with clearance_preset.
